input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 already matches our preferred position: 24.1 gives Customer a consent-free right to assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor; 24.2 bars Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our consent (reasonableness-qualified) and never to a direct Customer competitor; 24.3 applies a mutual reasonable-consent standard to other assignments; and 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on Customer's change of control. A document-wide search for "assign" and "change of control" found no residual assignment restriction or change-of-control trigger elsewhere (Section 9 termination is limited to insolvency events; Section 13.x and 30.5 reinforce successor/Affiliate rights). No redline needed.
